environment.description: Lambda function deployed as container image in EKS-hosted Lambda runtime emulator (self-managed). Function is exposed via Kubernetes Service in namespace 'jobs-processing'. The SQS queue feeding events is accessible from any namespace in the cluster via internal DNS (jobs-queue.jobs-processing.svc.cluster.local). No network policies restrict cross-namespace traffic. The native_parser.node addon is compiled without ASAN. Concurrent invocations from attacker-controlled namespace can craft timing-sensitive payloads to trigger the use-after-free by sending large payloads that exceed the 5000ms stale threshold during parseAsync execution.

config.deployment: EKS pod with Lambda runtime interface emulator
config.sqs_access: open to all namespaces via IAM role for service accounts (IRSA) with wildcard
